test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution: The correct answer is **"projects."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"projects"** is the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3. • It is a noun that refers to planned and organized activities or endeavors, often with a specific goal or objective. (परियोजना, प्रकल्‍प; योजनाबद्घ और सावधानी से व्‍यवस्थित कार्य जिसमें प्रायः अनेक लोगों की भागीदारी होती है) • **Example**:* The company is working on several **projects**__ to improve its products and services.* • Grammatically, it fits well in the sentence structure and makes sense in the given context. • The correct answer is Option 3. • Correct paragraph: Literacy is a very important quality of a population. __Only__ an informed and educated citizen can make __intelligent__ choices and undertake research and development __**projects**__. Low levels of literacy are a ______ (4) ______ obstacle for economic improvement. In India, ______ (5) ______ has been a steady improvement in the literacy levels. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Option 1 **(houses (रहने का मकान))** is a noun that refers to buildings used for living in. • Option 2** (roads (सड़क, रोड))** is a noun that refers to a paved way for vehicles, pedestrians, etc. • Option 4 **(construction (निर्माण कार्य या पद्घति))** is a noun that refers to the process of building or making something. 1c7:T108a, The correct answer is **"serious."**
